copy.tagline: 测试聊天功能是否正常
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速验证聊天模块是否可用
copy.tagline_en: Test if the chat function works
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly verify the chat module is working

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以从 Golden Chat 的 Slack 聊天存档中查找内容：包括 #engineering 和 #random 两个频道的消息、代码片段、共享链接等，用来回答团队讨论过的解决方案、排障步骤和架构决策。
howto.when: 当需求涉及 golden_chat 聊天记录内容时触发，例如查找讨论过的解决方案、引用团队分享的代码片段，或查询过去的排障步骤。

say.text: 从 golden_chat 里找出团队讨论过的排障步骤
say.note: Claude 会检索聊天记录并给出相关步骤。

say.text: 引用 golden_chat 中 bob 发的 Python 代码
say.note: Claude 会返回对应的代码片段。

say.text: golden_chat 里有哪些共享链接？
say.note: Claude 会列出聊天中的链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search and reference a preloaded Slack chat archive (golden_chat), including messages, code snippets, and shared links from #engineering and #random, to answer about solutions, troubleshooting steps, and team decisions discussed there.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the request involves content from the golden_chat chat history, such as finding discussed solutions, referencing team-shared code snippets, or looking up past troubleshooting steps.

say_en.text: Find troubleshooting steps discussed in golden_chat.
say_en.note: Claude will search the chat log and return relevant steps.

say_en.text: Reference the Python code bob shared in golden_chat.
say_en.note: Claude will return that code snippet.

say_en.text: What shared links are in golden_chat?
say_en.note: Claude will list the links from the chat.
